The legend shows: the blank bar represents population (thousand people), the dotted bar represents per capita cultivated land (mu), and the diagonal-line bar represents per capita grassland (mu). The question asks to compare cultivated land area, so it is necessary to read the population of the blank bar and the per capita cultivated land of the dotted bar. In the figure, the desert steppe population is about 20 thousand people, and per capita cultivated land is about 5 mu; the meadow steppe population is about 50 thousand people, and per capita cultivated land is more than about 10 mu; the agro-pastoral ecotone population is about 65 thousand people, and per capita cultivated land is about 25 mu. The desert steppe is about 20×5, the meadow steppe is about 50×more than 10, and the agro-pastoral ecotone is about 65×25. Comparing the products shows that the agro-pastoral ecotone is the largest, the meadow steppe region is second, and the desert steppe region is the smallest. Therefore, the cultivated land area pattern is: agro-pastoral ecotone > meadow steppe region > desert steppe region.
